photos.name: Royal Gujarati Grand Thali
photos.description: A stainless steel Gujarati thali with 3 small vegetable shaak bowls, sweet Gujarati dal, white kadhi, four thin phulka rotli, basmati rice, yellow khaman farsan, a small sweet, papad, pickle and a glass of chaas. Entirely vegetarian.

photos.name: Deluxe Gujarati Executive Thali
photos.description: A stainless steel Gujarati thali with 2 vegetable shaak bowls, dal, white kadhi, three phulka rotli, rice, khaman farsan and a glass of masala chaas. Entirely vegetarian.

photos.name: Khandvi with Mustard Tempering
photos.description: Silky thin yellow gram flour rolls arranged on a ceramic plate, topped with black mustard seeds, fresh grated coconut and chopped coriander.

photos.name: Methi Na Gota (Pakoda)
photos.description: Round golden brown crispy fried fenugreek and gram flour fritters with small visible green fenugreek flecks, served with a small bowl of creamy white sweet kadhi dip.

photos.name: Patra Steamed Rolls
photos.description: Sliced spiral colocasia leaf rolls with dark green leaf layers and golden spiced gram flour paste, lightly tempered with mustard and sesame seeds, Gujarati patra.

photos.name: Surti Undhiyu Special
photos.description: Rustic Gujarati undhiyu in a bowl: surti papdi beans, purple yam, baby eggplants, potatoes and methi muthia dumplings, green herb masala, dry slow-cooked mixed vegetables.

photos.name: Sev Tameta Nu Shaak
photos.description: Sweet tangy red tomato curry in a bowl, topped generously with thin crispy golden sev noodles and coriander, authentic Gujarati sev tameta.

photos.name: Ringna Bateta Nu Shaak
photos.description: Gujarati chunky aubergine and potato curry with purple eggplant skins, yellow potatoes and traditional red-brown spiced gravy.

photos.name: Bhindanu Shaak (Okra)
photos.description: Stir-fried sliced green okra with toasted peanuts, sesame seeds and dry Gujarati spices, dry vegetable preparation in a bowl, no paneer or gravy.

photos.name: Sweet Gujarati Toor Dal
photos.description: Thin golden pigeon pea lentil soup in a bowl, with whole peanuts, mustard seed tempering, curry leaves and small dried chilli.

photos.name: Traditional Gujarati Kadhi
photos.description: Creamy white pale-yellow yoghurt and besan soup in a bowl, cinnamon and cloves, curry leaves, ginger and mustard seed tempering; no pakora.

photos.name: Phulka Rotli (Ghee, 4 Pcs)
photos.description: Four paper-thin whole wheat rotli, softly puffed and folded on a plate, lightly brushed with ghee, browned griddle spots.

photos.name: Kathiyawadi Bajra Rotla (Ghee)
photos.description: Thick hand-flattened round grey-brown pearl millet flatbread with rustic cracked texture and roasted spots, served with white butter and jaggery. Not naan or samosa.

photos.name: Steamed Surti Basmati Rice
photos.description: A bowl of fluffy white long-grain steamed basmati rice, individual elongated grains clearly visible, no gravy or vegetables.

photos.name: Rich Basundi Bowl
photos.description: Creamy off-white reduced whole milk dessert in a bowl, slightly textured from simmering, topped with sliced almonds and light nutmeg. Not idli.

photos.name: Methi Thepla (4 Pcs)
photos.description: Four thin golden spiced wheat flatbreads with visible green fenugreek flecks stacked on a plate, sweet mango chundo in small ramekin.

photos.name: Kesar Pista Shrikhand (150g)
photos.description: Thick smooth pale yellow hung-curd dessert in a small bowl, saffron strands, sliced pistachios and cardamom, rich spoonable texture. Not idli.

photos.name: Vaghareli Khichdi with Kadhi
photos.description: Golden soft rice and moong lentil khichdi tempered with garlic, onions, cloves and whole spices, in a bowl paired with a separate bowl of creamy white Gujarati kadhi.

photos.name: Indian Multi-Cuisine Diner Meal Deal
photos.description: A vegetarian meal on a white plate: red-orange paneer lababdar curry in a small bowl with clearly visible paneer cubes and a mound of fluffy white steamed basmati rice beside it.

photos.name: Biscuit Bhakri (2 Pcs)
photos.description: Two thick crisp golden round Gujarati wheat and semolina bhakri discs, concentric roast patterns, lightly glazed with ghee.

photos.name: Kathiyawadi Masala Chaas
photos.description: A tall glass of chilled white buttermilk with roasted cumin, coriander and a hint of green chilli, simple Gujarati chaas.

photos.name: Surti Nylon Khaman (250g)
photos.description: Soft airy yellow steamed gram flour cakes, mustard seeds, green chillies, curry leaves and fresh coconut.
